svg.aria-label: Specimen 01, currently building: HealthLens, an end-to-end healthcare ML playground. Data with pandas and Polars, models with scikit-learn, XGBoost and PyTorch, SHAP explanations, Hugging Face NER, served with FastAPI, PostgreSQL and React, tracked with MLflow and Docker Compose.
